Method of Attack: Backdoor Google accounts using malicious OAuth applications installed from Google Marketplace or third-party providers
Make malicious apps invisible by exploiting OAuth token authorization and linked GCP project deletion/restoration
Convert authorized third-party app into malicious trojan app with permanent unremovable access
Delete and restore GCP project to hide malicious app while maintaining access via refresh tokens
Impacted Systems: Google apps (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Photos, Calendar)
Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Google Compute)
Attack Vector: Malicious OAuth applications installed from Google Marketplace or third-party providers
Exploitation of OAuth token authorization and GCP project deletion state
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious apps entering 'pending deletion' state by deleting linked GCP project
Malicious apps hidden from Google's application management page
Use of refresh tokens to regain access after project restoration
